Ritual XP increased by exactly 10.

Initial staged inputs are explicit in `evidence.json`: player at the original local registry, adult age, ritual level, accepted interview seed and starting clock. NPC positions, original objects, work, receipts, attendance and pay were not staged. The ordinary ground-to-fourth-floor route has separate evidence.

The default main test cold-loads this exact paid save without replaying unrelated or already-passed work. Its `currentRun` output distinguishes new assertions from inherited evidence. This is simulated DOM/renderer plus actual production main, Three and navigation; it is not browser/GPU/iOS validation.
